fee_notes: Royalty Fee is the greater of 4% of Gross Revenues or a minimum monthly royalty that scales by year of operation: Year 1 = $800, Year 2 = $1,600, Year 3+ = $2,400. Marketing/Advertising Fee is the greater of 1% of Gross Revenues or $500/month. ASAP-Rent (mandatory fleet management system) fee varies by fleet size: minimum $189/month (Basic, 1-49 vehicles) up to $9,900+/month (2000+ vehicles) at $5.50-$8.00 per vehicle per month. ASAP Rates Platform Fee is $89/month (captured as tech_fee_monthly). Additional tech/training fees: Rental Car Online University $27/month (you + 3 employees), $9/month each additional employee. Annual Meeting Pre-Payment $50/month. Priceless Reservation Fee: $5/reservation + 5% commission on time and mileage revenue via PricelessCarRental.com. GDS Fees: $9-$12/reservation. XML OTA Channel Fee: $5/reservation. Travel Agency Commissions: 10%-35% of time and mileage revenue. Late Payment Fee: 5% of amount owed, minimum $15. Credit Card Processing Fee: 4.5% of transaction. Transfer Fee: $4,000 or 5% of sale price, whichever is greater. Damage Waiver Fee: up to $28/waiver sold (currently $19.60). Reservations Reconnection Fee: $300. Vehicle Acquisition Fee: $350/transaction. Insufficient Funds Administrative Fee: $45. All flat fees may increase annually up to 30%; percentage-based fees are not subject to annual increases.

Royalty Fee The greater of: (a) 4% of Gross Revenues received during the preceding month (See Note 3); and (b) the monthly minimum royalty | Payable on or before the 10th day of each month for the prior month | The minimum monthly Royalty Fee varies from $800 to $2,400 depending upon the length of time that your Franchised Business has been operating (See Note 4)
Marketing and Advertising Fee The greater of: (a) 1% of Gross Revenues received during the preceding month (See Note 3); and (b) $500 | Payable on or before the 10th day of each month for the prior month
Priceless Reservation Fee Currently, $5 per reservation plus 5% commission on time and mileage revenue for all reservations received through PricelessCarRental.com.
Global Distribution System ("GDS") Fees Currently: $9.00 - $12 per reservation for reservations received from GDS sources.
XML Online Travel Agent ("OTA") Channel Fee Currently: $5 per reservation for reservations received from XML OTA channels
Travel Agency Commissions 10%-35% of time and mileage revenue.
ASAP - Rent Greater of: (a) the applicable Cost per Vehicle per Month; and (b) the Minimum Monthly Fee (See Note 9) | Participation in ASAP-Rent is mandatory.
ASAP Rates Platform Fee $89 per month
Rental Car Online University Fee $27 per month for you and 3 employees ($9 per month for each additional employee)
Annual Meeting and Training Pre-Payment Program $50 per month
Late Payment Fee 5% of amount owed - minimum late fee equal to $15.
Credit Card Processing Fee Currently 4.5% of transaction amount
Transfer Fee $4,000 or 5% of the sale price, whichever is greater
Damage Waiver Fee Up to $28 for each damage waiver sold. Currently, the fee is $19.60
Reservations Reconnection Fee $300
Vehicle Acquisition Fee $350 per transaction
Insufficient Funds Administrative Fee $45
Year of Operation / Minimum Monthly Royalty Fee: 1=$800, 2=$1,600, 3+=$2,400
